note: Independently re-judged against committed a617f53893dab242be088ea985b9baae7e66c430. RFC 7296 Section 1.4.1 states: "When an SA is closed, both members of the pair MUST be closed (that is, deleted)." It also states: "Each endpoint MUST close its incoming SAs and allow the other endpoint to close the other SA in each pair." handleCreateChildSAOwned deletes a locally refused successful Child rekey answer with sendDeleteESP(p.newInboundSPI), retaining the current child. Error-notify refusals remain distinct because they created no replacement pair. TestRFC7296RefusedRekeyAnswerDeletesTheNewPair exercises the missing-Nr refusal through the authenticated-response relay, asserting no new installation, preservation of the old child and an authenticated ESP Delete naming the new inbound SPI; this relay is not a full owner-loop dispatch test. TestLcyClosingAChildSAClosesBothHalvesAndDeletesOurInbound drives retirement through handleOwnedInbound, distinguishes inbound from outbound SPI and asserts removal of both states on cleanup. cleanupChild/removeChildSAExcept preserve surviving shared policies without retaining the closed pair. Verdict retained from source review; no new execution result is claimed by this rejudgment.
